description: The bounded views governance visualize can render. Each is generated from a graph slice, never from the whole graph, and truncation is always visible in the output.

views.title: Component architecture
views.description: Components and their declared dependencies, grouped frontend / application / data-and-infrastructure.
views.focus: Optional component id: restricts the view to the component and its direct neighbors.

views.title: Site map
views.description: Pages joined to the proxy handlers and backend route modules they reach, with the WebSocket exception drawn as its own edge.
views.focus: Optional page route (for example /chat): renders that page's chain alone.

views.title: Change impact
views.description: The blast radius of a change: touched path, reverse importers, components, proxy handlers, and the validators that prove it.
views.focus: Required repo-relative path the change touches.

views.title: Configuration flow
views.description: Environment variables and the components that consume them.
views.focus: Optional variable name or component id: restricts to that name and its neighbors.

views.title: Migration graph
views.description: The Alembic revision chain in order, branches and merges visible, heads marked.

views.title: Agent and MCP permission map
views.description: The agent, its tool sources, and the gate each source does or does not pass through, with the standing security findings attached.
